limits: This ledger verifies named events, not all classical games in the source. Selection is unrelated to engine scores but event coverage differs by year.
A pilot from this restricted pool estimates event-conditional variance and throughput; it cannot support historical effect estimates or a full-corpus sample size.
The independent archives can share upstream scores with Lumbra; matching checks score and identity consistency, not independent eyewitness verification.
